name: Deep Learning
description: Neural networks end to end: backprop, PyTorch, CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs and transformers — from perceptron to attention.

items.title: Dive into Deep Learning (d2l.ai)
items.description: Interactive deep-learning textbook with code in PyTorch.

items.title: Practical Deep Learning — fast.ai
items.description: A top-down course that gets you training models quickly.

items.title: Deep Learning — Goodfellow et al.
items.description: The canonical textbook on deep learning (free HTML).

items.title: PyTorch Documentation
items.description: The official reference for the deep-learning framework.

items.title: PyTorch Tutorials
items.description: Step-by-step tutorials for tensors, autograd and models.

items.title: Attention Is All You Need
items.description: The paper that introduced the Transformer architecture.

lessons.title: What Is Deep Learning?
lessons.description: Why deep learning took over AI: representation learning, scale, and the hardware that made it possible.

lessons.title: The Perceptron & Linear Units
lessons.description: Start with the neuron: linear combination, threshold, and the step up to learnable weights.

lessons.title: Activation Functions
lessons.description: Nonlinearity is what makes deep networks expressive — sigmoid, tanh, ReLU and friends.

lessons.title: Forward Propagation
lessons.description: Push data through the network layer by layer and understand the shapes at every step.

lessons.title: Backpropagation
lessons.description: The chain rule in action: propagate errors backward to compute gradients for every weight.

lessons.title: Loss Functions
lessons.description: Pick the right objective: MSE for regression, cross-entropy for classification, and why it matters.

lessons.title: Optimizers: SGD, Momentum & Adam
lessons.description: From plain SGD to Adam — how optimizers navigate loss landscapes and converge faster.

lessons.title: PyTorch Tensors & Autograd
lessons.description: The PyTorch fundamentals: tensors, dtypes, devices, and the autograd graph.

lessons.title: Building an MLP in PyTorch
lessons.description: Assemble a multi-layer perceptron with nn.Module, layers and activations — the skeleton of every modern net.

lessons.title: The Training Loop
lessons.description: Write the loop that every training run shares: batches, forward, loss, backward, step.

lessons.title: Regularization for Deep Learning
lessons.description: Dropout, weight decay, early stopping and data augmentation — fight overfitting without shrinking capacity.

lessons.title: Convolutional Networks
lessons.description: Why convolutions beat dense layers for images: local structure, weight sharing, and translation invariance.

lessons.title: Classic CNN Architectures
lessons.description: LeNet, VGG, ResNet — the ideas (depth, skip connections) that shaped modern vision models.

lessons.title: Transfer Learning
lessons.description: Stand on the shoulders of pretrained models: freeze features, swap the head, and fine-tune.

lessons.title: Recurrent Neural Networks
lessons.description: Process sequences with a hidden state that carries context through time.

lessons.title: LSTM & GRU
lessons.description: Gated memory cells that actually remember — the fixes that made sequence modeling practical.

lessons.title: Transformers
lessons.description: The architecture behind modern AI: self-attention, positional encoding, and parallelized sequence processing.

lessons.title: Attention Mechanisms
lessons.description: Query-key-value attention, multi-head splits, and how attention replaced recurrence.

lessons.title: Training at Scale
lessons.description: GPUs, mixed precision, data loaders and distributed training — the practical side of big models.

lessons.title: Evaluating Deep Learning Models
lessons.description: Accuracy is not enough: confusion matrices, calibration, and failure-case analysis for neural nets.

lessons.title: Deep Learning Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize the course: choose a specialization (vision, NLP, generative), and plan real training projects.
